wth.text: In Weatherlight, Yawgmoth waits poised to invade Dominaria, four thousand years after Urza and Mishra reopened the portal to Phyrexia.
Sisay sets out to gather the Legacy, which she knows can kill the Lord of the Wastes, and Gerrard must face his blood brother Vuel, who as Volrath became Yawgmoth's first in command.
Yawgmoth's reach also touches the crew directly, as he grants Squee immortality so Ertai and Crovax can kill him repeatedly, and he recreates Selenia as a puppet to reward Crovax.
The set also looks back to the Thran, where Yawgmoth was recalled from exile to heal Glacian, discovered that powerstones cause phthisis, and used the sickness to eliminate his enemies.

sth.text: In Stronghold, Yawgmoth is the Phyrexian master whose vision the Stronghold architect serves, and in his realm Kirril compleats Crovax into a Phyrexian whom he grooms as evincar of Rath.

usg.text: In Urza's Saga, Yawgmoth, the father of machines, drives the Grand Evolution, after he usurped the Thran Empire and set off a civil war that collapsed it.
Rebbec had sealed the portal to Phyrexia and locked him out for millennia, until Urza and Mishra took the powerstone and accidentally reopened it, and Yawgmoth sent Gix to scout.

Urza later learned that Gix corrupted Mishra and attacked Phyrexia, blasting a hole down to the Fourth Sphere, but Yawgmoth drove him off and invaded his mind, and "Yawgmoth brushed Urza's mind, and Urza's world convulsed."

uds.text: In Urza's Destiny, Yawgmoth is a Phyrexian master whose coming invasion drives Urza to prepare.
Urza secretly starts the Bloodline Project to create mortal heroes who can wield the Legacy against Yawgmoth, and creates the Metathran to resist him.

nem.text: In Nemesis, Yawgmoth's presence is felt through those who serve him, as in Phyrexia Abcal-dro rebuilds Avila as the cyborg Belbe and implants the Eye of Yawgmoth in her, though she grows disillusioned and disables it.
After the Rathi Overlay, Crovax oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.

inv.text: In Invasion, Yawgmoth launches the Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR after millennia of planning, and the Dominarian forces unite to push him back.

He tempts Gerrard with a false promise to revive Hanna and brings Urza to worship him, then makes Gerrard and Urza duel, and Gerrard beheads Urza and discovers that the Hanna he fought for was Yawgmoth in disguise.
Yawgmoth then arrives on Dominaria as a world-spanning black death cloud that kills billions and reanimates the dead, and Guff, Bo Levar, Eladamri and Sivvi en-Vec are among those killed.
The Legacy is completed by the sacrifice of Urza, Gerrard and Karn, which destroys Yawgmoth's essence and ends the invasion.

pls.text: In Planeshift, Yawgmoth shows Urza his tortured brother Mishra, and Urza leaves him and prostrates himself before Yawgmoth, as Gerrard pledges allegiance as well.
Yawgmoth also gets Urza to destroy the master soul bomb, and he offers Crovax the reward of killing Ertai, who Crovax says he will kill a hundred times a day.

apc.text: In Apocalypse, Yawgmoth sets Gerrard and Urza to fight in an arena filled with his avatars, promising to grant the winner's wish, and Gerrard wins by decapitating Urza, rejects Yawgmoth's reward and sees through a Hanna-avatar.
The remaining Nine Titans gut Phyrexia with the last Soul Bomb, but Yawgmoth has already left and arrives on Dominaria as a death cloud that kills Guff, Eladamri and Sivvi and most of Vodalia.
He takes control of the Null Sphere and the Weatherlight's white mana channeled through the Null Moon fails to kill him.
In the end, Karn, Urza and Gerrard merge into a radiant light that defeats Yawgmoth.

dom.text: In Dominaria, the story of Yawgmoth goes back to the Thran Empire, where Rebbec used her influence to recall him from exile to cure Glacian, and the two began falling in love without acting on it.

Yawgmoth diluted the serum given to the Untouchables to provoke another insurrection, took over the Halcyte Guard, and, after the vote on his stay split evenly, overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders and the delegates.

Dyfed cracked a powerstone to open a permanent portal to Phyrexia, where Yawgmoth took control of the artificial plane, merged himself with Rebbec and proposed that they rule together, which she refused.

In the Thran-Phyrexian War Yawgmoth won at Megheddon Defile with the Null Sphere, until Rebbec returned to find Glacian dead and Halcyon devastated and placed the powerstone on the pedestal to seal him away from Dominaria.
